lines.en: - I just wanted to tell you something
before you heard it from someone else,
and I hope this isn't too weird,
but, uh, I had a thing with Janice.
there are certain rules about this kind of stuff.
You don't, uh, you don't fool around
But you know what I'm gonna do?
when they do everything you just said,
all the things on the list there.
Well, but I want you to remember
- I also want you to remember
that I let you live here rent-free.
- And I want you to remember
Now, if you can't remember that,
I think we should write it down.
